implementation_choices.curve_probability: Cached segmentation[0,1], already sigmoid in ChartParserModel.forward; no second activation.
implementation_choices.probability_inconsistency: Paper section 3.2.3 says two-channel Softmax, section 3.2.4 discusses Sigmoid, and the public forward applies independent Sigmoid. This run thresholds the released cached Sigmoid output directly, not a claim of identical paper Softmax probabilities.
implementation_choices.morphology: One 3x3 all-ones binary closing; constant-zero border.
implementation_choices.component_policy: Retain every connected component; no minimum-area deletion.
implementation_choices.correction: Nearest centreline pixel in x +/- 1 columns and abs(delta_y) < 15 model pixels; minimum Euclidean distance, ties smaller y then x. Snap x and y to that centreline pixel. Reject if absent.
implementation_choices.correction_parameters_provenance: The paper does not specify kernel/thinner/selection radius. Column band and vertical radius are borrowed from public process_kps; nearest selection and exact snapping are explicit experimental choices.
implementation_choices.public_reference: Separate result using original argmax mask, public x +/- 1, y-run gap <= 2, first ascending-y mean within 15, average with original y. Safety bounds added; not used for grouping.
implementation_choices.pivot_patch_coordinate_system: Native original-resolution upright input crop, not the 512x512 model input.
implementation_choices.legend_images: Unmodified original RGB swatch box crops, connector pixels retained. No reconstructed swatch masks.
implementation_choices.grouping: Official LineEX learned Siamese + MLP similarity, highest score over supplied legend crops. No histogram override or confidence rejection.
implementation_choices.shape_classification: Not performed. Legend identity is not a semantic circle/square/triangle prediction.
implementation_choices.deduplication: None. Distinct raw pivot hypotheses can snap to the same pixel and remain separate records.
implementation_choices.no_legend_policy: Abstain from grouping even for a nominal single-series panel; no fabricated legend.

native_legend_stage: unavailable; supplied benchmark swatch crops used, never class-3 remapping
limitations: Annotated shared plot/legend ROI; actual observed source-pixel swatch crops exported by v46 are shared. Not an end-to-end chart parser.
Native swatch IDs mapped to supplied IDs by bbox-only overlap; then learned swatch argmax. Unmapped extra swatches retain their unknown ID. No reference-point matching.
If the shared legend front end failed, actual scoped head/corrected locations remain as unknown-series predictions for center-only evaluation; no legend or marker is fabricated.
A valid detection whose native 40x20 patch crosses the image edge is retained as unknown_patch_unavailable, not dropped or padded.
Scores are learned similarities, not calibrated correctness probabilities.
Fixed native 40x20 patches, learned RGB Siamese matcher; no histogram override.
Pivot locations may not correspond to visible markers. No semantic marker-shape classification.
No reference targets, reference curves, reference point positions, or shape labels read.
No deduplication or score threshold added after highest-similarity legend assignment.
